name: decomp-permuter
notes: Python source copy of upstream main at commit 8556c81d (2026-10-06); no release tags exist upstream. Copied files checked against that commit: src/main.py, src/compiler.py, src/objdump.py, src/permuter.py, src/scorer.py, permuter.py. Smoke test builds a tiny MIPS function with the IDO 7.1 compiler from ~/Decomp/tools/vendor and runs the permuter in --debug and --stop-on-zero modes. Test depends on that IDO compiler and on the MIPS binutils in ~/Library/Application Support/decompnet/toolchains/binutils-mips. The app folder also carries prebuilt Windows/Linux systray binaries from upstream that are unused on macOS.
